title: Sisu
desc: As WWII comes to an end, Aatami Korpi trudges towards retirement with a bag full of gold. However, when a Nazi soldier learns about the treasure, he chases after the warrior, unaware of his prowess.

title: A Few Good Men
desc: A young navy lawyer investigates the death of two marines. He must battle the commanding officer of the base who doesn't want the whole story told.

title: The Pope'S Exorcist
desc: Glimpses of the events that exorcist father Gabriele Amorth's experiences while assisting a possessed child and revealing a conspiracy that has been kept secret within the Vatican for years.

title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
desc: The Life between Eddie Brock and the parasitic Venom becomes unbearable, but both must agree to a truce when the city is threatened by a ferocious serial killer, who hosts a dangerously alien symbiote.

title: Vertical Limit
desc: Peter Garrett, finds himself in a challenging position when his sister and her team get trapped in a icy cave atop the world's 2nd highest mountain, K2.

desc: When aliens that have the ability to shape-shift into humans arrive on Earth, Agent H joins forces with Agent M, a new recruit, to save the planet.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
desc: Peter Parker grapples with his dual identity as a teenager and the burgeoning superhero, Spider-Man, balancing the extraordinary with the ordinary challenges of youth.

title: Life
desc: A team of scientists aboard the International Space Station finds a rapidly evolving life form that caused extinction on Mars, and now threatens the crew and all life on Earth.

title: Hotel Transylvania
desc: In the resort of the monsters where humans are banned, Dracula must do everything to keep his daughter from falling in love with a human!

title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
desc: Six people are captured in a perilous game of escape rooms. To survive, they must team up with two original survivors, but as the rounds go, they wonder if this is a game they've been through before.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt For The Blood Orchid
desc: Searching feral jungles for orchids which contain youth serum scientists find anacondas who've eaten them - bigger smarter more lethal than ever.

title: The Equalizer 3
desc: Robert McCall returns to Southern Italy to find his friends under the control of mafia crime bosses. He becomes their protector, risking everything to fight back against the mafia.

title: Terminator Salvation
desc: John leads human resistance against Skynet and its army of Terminators after much of humanity is destroyed in a nuclear holocaust.
